core_insight: When researching a specific problem, Noxtua only conceded that a cited source did not exist after the user explicitly asked. Users want it to state clearly and unprompted when something does not exist.

For a guideline supplied as an external source carrying annotations from three different stakeholders, the summary delivered 5–6 well-reasoned wording alternatives, including why a given formulation fits a given fact pattern.

core_insight: Users want to view and browse the content templates provided by the publisher, and see example templates as inspiration for their own drafting.
Using Noxtua to challenge previously written briefs worked as a use case, but source referencing in that scenario was noticeably weak.
Recent case law that is publicly available is missing from the sources, which lowers the perceived added value over free internet research.
Coverage of legal literature is rated very strong, with case law also good.
Users want scholarly disputes (Meinungsstreit) and unsettled legal questions presented explicitly as contested, rather than as a single confident answer.
